task: Add end-to-end tests for the sign-in portal (`/`). Acceptance criteria: (1) signing in with the demo account (email `ada@example.com`, access code `4471`) replaces the form with the dashboard, which greets `Welcome, Ada`; (2) a wrong access code keeps the sign-in form and shows the error `Invalid email or access code`; (3) submitting without an email shows the error `Email is required`; (4) a signed-in session survives a page reload; (5) Sign out returns to the sign-in form and ends the session on the server, so a reload still shows the form. The test seam `POST /api/reset` drops every session.

faults.description: A successful sign-in leaves the form on screen; the dashboard appears only after a reload.
Any access code signs the demo account in.
The wrong-code error reads `Sign-in failed` instead of the specified text.
The server never recognises the session cookie, so a reload shows the sign-in form again.
Sign out hides the dashboard but the server keeps the session; a reload shows the dashboard again.
